title: QA run · release-18.2.0-tier1 (131/156) · 6679644a · 2026-10-25 · 6 PASS / 123 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 2 BLOCKED / 25 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record — **objectstack 18.2.0 release candidate, Tier 1 full re-run** (`checklist-test` §5 retest trigger 1: a release candidate ⇒ full Tier 1). Vehicle: Version Packages #25640. Wave anchor: #25807 (`[sweep] v18.2.0 release test sweep`). Sister records of this wave: #25812 (`priority:P0`, 23/23); the manual-set record follows from its own run. Previous Tier 1 record: #24840 (`tier1:24681-touched`, 82 items, closed).

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework `6679644a1a56b552d6864b125900221823ec78b3` (= `origin/main` at run start, 14:16Z). `.objectui-sha` `b41ed7f68956c8cfda21bc790548361af81b09ac`.
- Cold container: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 28 s; `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 76/76 in 7m34s; `check-dev-prereqs` green.
- objectui at the pin: a detached worktree at `b41ed7f68956`, `objectstack-pin.mjs build` with `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` = this framework tree (the stand-in, so objectui's `@objectstack/*` are 6679644a's — the pairing the release ships), then a frozen install.
- Vendored console: `pnpm objectui:build` at the pin with `OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD='… --concurrency=2 …'`, 9m44s; `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` = the pin. Built only after every framework pin had finished (RUNNER: one container builds one tree at a time).
- vitest: one package per invocation, `--maxWorkers=1`, JSON reporter; the one cli `*.e2e.test.*` pin in its own invocation under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`, every other cli pin without it.
- Live stacks (each its own file DB under `/tmp`, `--seed-admin`, `OS_PORT` exported beside `-p`, started with `setsid` and stopped by process group): (1) showcase `objectstack dev` on :3000 + objectui console dev server (Vite, the pin's tree) on :5180 for objectui's `e2e/live` specs; (2) showcase on :3000 serving the vendored console at `/_console` for `examples/app-showcase` Playwright. Chromium via `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` (alias; Playwright 1.62.1 / 1.63.0 trees).
- Timestamps (UTC, 2026-10-25): env prep 14:17–14:26; framework pins 14:25–15:05; objectui unit pins 14:27–14:30; objectui live e2e 14:31–14:40; extra pins 15:05; console build 15:06–15:16; showcase Playwright 15:17–15:19; probes 15:20. Clause mapping 14:22–14:37.
- Clause mapping: five parallel read-only mapping subagents (34/29/33/30/30 items), each re-deriving every clause from the item text and the pin source on this tree, with #24840 read only for comparison. Pins executed by the parent, sequentially per package; no pin ran while a build was writing the tree.
- Env prep vs test: ~19 min of builds (install, framework build, console build) against ~57 min of pin execution.

## Scope

Selector `release-18.2.0-tier1`: every **active** item whose `automated.ref` is set, read from `areas/AREA.json` at 6679644a (`--json` does not project the ref). **156 items** across 15 areas, 1178 clauses. Two of them carry `blocked` (`access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` by fixture #9334; `records-forms.record-edit-undo`: no packaged undoable update action in the showcase) and are recorded BLOCKED with that reason; their pins still ran green. No `planned` item carries a ref, so none is in scope (`records-forms.picklist-shared-across-objects` is planned and out of this selector). Each row below carries the revision its verdict is valid for.

## Pin run

| pins | files | tests |
|---|---|---|
| framework vitest, 41 packages | 374 | 10,009 passed · 0 failed · 1 skipped |
| framework vitest, tests the mapping found asserting a clause but missing from the ref (`flow-run-semantics-v18` ×2, `i18n.flow-copy…` ×3, `import-invitation…` ×1) | 6 | 91 passed · 0 failed |
| `examples/app-showcase` Playwright (vendored console at the pin) | 3 specs | 53 passed (`showcase-smoke.spec.ts` 49/49) |
| objectui vitest at the pin | 29 | 378 passed · 0 failed |
| objectui `e2e/live` Playwright at the pin | 20 specs | 31 passed · 0 failed |
| `objectstack verify --rls` on the showcase (the `verify`-kind refs) | — | CRUD tail `15 verified, 0 gaps, 0 FAILED, 1 needs-fixture, 8 skipped`; per-persona `21 PROVEN (21 consistent, 0 HOLES)`; positions `10 of 10 declared position(s) probed`; total `all personas: 38 PROVEN (38 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 226 NOT PROVEN` [unit: one object × persona probe] |

Every named file collected at least one test. The one skipped test (`attachments-permission-matrix.dogfood.test.ts` › cross-tenant isolation (g)) is cited by no clause.

Not run, recorded per clause:
- `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel` a1/n0 — `blocked(fixture)`: `e2e/import-console/import-console-undo.spec.ts` self-skips unless `IMPORT_CONSOLE_LIVE=1` and targets `crm_app`/`crm_lead` (an app-crm boot); its harness twin `e2e/import-harness/import-undo.spec.ts` needs the plugin-grid demo harness on :5200 over app-crm on :3002. A forced attempt on the showcase (`LIVE_IMPORT_OBJECT=showcase_task`) stopped at a disabled Next because the spec's CSV headers do not map the showcase's required fields — my fixture substitution, not a product reading.
- `cli.scaffold-first-run` — its ref is `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml`. Newest scheduled run on main: 40158961882, success, at `4cc17db3c0` (03:38Z), 29 commits before this subject, none touching `packages/create-objectstack` or the cli `dev`/`serve` commands. A verdict is valid only for the subject it ran on, so all 7 clauses stay not-run here.

## How a pin scores (RUNNER rule 6, "a pin scores only the layer it drives")

Each row names the layer its pins drive: `unit` (functions or handlers over fakes/stubs), `in-process` (a real kernel/engine/driver, no HTTP — this run also counts `RestServer`/`HttpDispatcher`/route entries called directly with no Hono adapter here), `http-in-process` (a real Hono adapter in-process, e.g. the dogfood harness), `live-boot`, `browser` (Playwright against a live stack), `component` (objectui vitest + jsdom, mocked fetch). A clause scores `pass` only when a named pin asserts it at the oracle's layer. Following #24840's reading, a clause whose pin stops above that layer is recorded `not-run` naming the missing layer, and an item with no scoring clause is NOT-RUN. **Of the 861 not-run clauses: 254 are layer-limited (a pin asserts them at a lower layer), 132 are half-asserted, 50 are procedural, the rest have no pin.** Under the literal "scores that clause partial" wording, 23 of the 25 NOT-RUN items would read PARTIAL instead; the title follows the precedent.

Clauses: 315 pass · 0 fail · 2 blocked · 861 not-run, of 1178. **No pin failed and no clause failed**, so rule 7's verify pass had nothing to re-derive and there is nothing to extract.

- **Lower (9), no pin red** — each move is a revision change or the stricter layer reading above, never a failing test: `access-security.grant-table-write-contract PASS→PARTIAL (rev 5→6)`, `integration-system.connector-descriptor-audit PARTIAL→NOT-RUN`, `api-backend.query-contract-matrix PARTIAL→NOT-RUN (rev 4→5)`, `access-security.share-link-combined-gates PASS→PARTIAL`, `automation.inbound-hook-timestamped-signature PASS→PARTIAL`, `records-forms.field-type-constraints PARTIAL→NOT-RUN (rev 2→3)`, `access-security.parent-and-organization-write-guards PASS→PARTIAL (rev 4→5)`, `approvals.decision-only-via-service PASS→NOT-RUN (rev 1→2)`, `records-forms.delete-behavior-matrix PARTIAL→NOT-RUN (rev 2→3)`.
